title: Pseudo-coherent derived objects over a ring
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $C$ be an object of the derived category $D(A)$ of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Call $C$ pseudo-coherent if there exists a bounded-above complex $E^\bullet$ of finite free $A$-modules whose image in $D(A)$ is isomorphic to $C$, that is, $C$ is quasi-isomorphic to a bounded-above complex of finite free $A$-modules.
